title: VOLUME: MASTER, MUSIC AND EFFECTS
why: A AAA game has volume controls and this one had none: the only sound choices were which window plays and the split. Settings gains Master, Music and Effects rows, Off to Full, applied at once. The defaults are the game as it was.
now: Settings has Master, Music and Effects volume rows.

edits.replacement:
MUS.lvl=lvl; lvl=lvl*volOf('volMusic')*volOf('volMaster');   // v16.xx: the volume rows scale the level the music asks for
  MUS.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(lvl,a.currentTime,0.9);
